ldap_server.description: Hostname or IP address of the LDAP server to connect to.

ldap_port.description: Port number for the LDAP server (typically 389 for non-SSL, 636 for LDAPS).

ldap_use_ssl.description: Whether to use SSL/TLS for the LDAP connection (recommended for production).

ldap_bind_dn.description: Distinguished Name (DN) used to bind to the LDAP directory for read-only access.

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for the bind DN. Keep secret; consider using a secure credential store in production.

ldap_base_dn.description: Base DN for LDAP searches (e.g., the root of your directory tree).

user_base.description: Optional custom base DN for user searches. Defaults to `ldap_base_dn` if empty.

user_attributes.description: Comma-separated list of LDAP attributes to fetch for users.

group_base.description: Optional custom base DN for group searches. Defaults to `ldap_base_dn` if empty.

group_attributes.description: Comma-separated list of LDAP attributes to fetch for groups.

sync_enabled.description: Enable automatic synchronization of users and groups from LDAP.

group_mappings.description: List of mappings from LDAP groups to local Linux groups (used for sudo, network, etc.).

ldap_group.description: Name of the LDAP group (e.g., `admin` or `students`).

local_group.description: Name of the local system group to map to (e.g., `sudo` or `netdev`).

ldap_ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate file for verifying LDAP server identity (e.g., `/etc/ssl/certs/ldap-ca.crt`). Optional; leave empty to skip verification.
